name: Adam, The First
summary: The conduit of Zero and the only opening to 2nd-grade Dynamic: he finds the deck's rarest Matter and, when he goes, leaves something to those who remain.

face.name: Adam, The First

genesis.name: Genesis
genesis.text: search your deck for a Zero Matter card, reveal it and add it to your hand. You cannot play or discard that card this turn.

face.flavor: He was the first to touch Zero. Humankind was never the same.
